row: Black Diamond Chiropractic and Sports Performance

Welcome to Black Diamond Chiropractic & Sports Performance on YouTube! I’m Dr. Zach Higgins, DC, MS, CCSP — a sports-focused chiropractor passionate about helping athletes and active people move better, recover faster, and reach their peak potential.

My goal is to make high-quality, trustworthy information accessible so you can feel confident about your body and your training.

⚠️ Disclaimer: Content on this channel is for educational purposes only and does not substitute for individualized medical advice. Please consult a qualified healthcare provider for personal concerns.

Subscribe and hit the bell 🔔 so you don’t miss the next episode — and drop your condition ideas in the comments!
